$comment: Canvas hashes at fixed, fully-built states. Regenerate with the Copy new baseline button in widgets/_lab/fingerprint.html, and commit the new baseline in the SAME commit as the change that moved the rendering. Every state must pass shown= so nothing is animating; an animating figure hashes differently every run. Hashes are viewport-dependent: the harness renders into a fixed 900px frame, so do not change FRAME_W without regenerating.
